scope.zh: MLPerf 近三个轮次、系统与CPU基准（MLPerf Storage、InferenceX、SPEC CPU 2026、AgentSysBench）、智能体基准（SWE-bench、Terminal-Bench、OSWorld、GAIA、METR、GDPval、τ-bench、MCP-Atlas、Toolathlon、BrowseComp）以及读基准的问题。不给排名：智能体榜单的领先者在不同聚合站之间互相矛盾，这里只写基准测什么、规模和已知口径问题。厂商自报结果单独标注。 另含综合指数与第一方套件（Artificial Analysis、CursorBench）。
scope.en: The last three MLPerf rounds, system and CPU benchmarks (MLPerf Storage, InferenceX, SPEC CPU 2026, AgentSysBench), agentic benchmarks (SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench, OSWorld, GAIA, METR, GDPval, τ-bench, MCP-Atlas, Toolathlon, BrowseComp) and questions for reading them. No rankings: agentic leaderboard leaders conflict between aggregators, so this page states what each benchmark measures, its scale and known basis problems. Vendor self-reports are labelled. Also covers composite indexes and first-party suites (Artificial Analysis, CursorBench).

primary-read.zh: 已打开并阅读官方原文。
primary-read.en: Official primary document opened and read.

primary-located.zh: 已定位官方来源，细节取自搜索摘要，未逐字核对。
primary-located.en: Official source located; details come from search summaries, not checked verbatim.

secondary-authoritative.zh: 权威机构或行业组织的二手转述。
secondary-authoritative.en: Relayed by an authoritative body or trade press.

secondary.zh: 媒体或聚合站摘要，数字可能因口径或时点不同而冲突。
secondary.en: Press or aggregator summary; figures may conflict by scope or timing.

editorial.zh: 本站对财报问答与来源的编辑归纳，不是已核实结论。
editorial.en: This site’s editorial synthesis of Q&A and sources; not a verified conclusion.

index.zh: 综合指数与第一方基准

summary.zh: MLCommons称这是推理套件迄今最大的一次修订：11项数据中心测试中5项为新增或更新，并新增边缘目标检测测试。
summary.en: MLCommons describes it as the largest revision of the inference suite so far: five of eleven datacenter tests are new or updated, plus a new edge object-detection test.

facts.zh: 新增基于 GPT-OSS 120B 的开源权重LLM测试，以及允许推测解码的 DeepSeek-R1 交互场景。
facts.en: New open-weight LLM test built on GPT-OSS 120B, and a DeepSeek-R1 interactive scenario that permits speculative decoding.

facts.zh: 第三方分析（NAND Research）称 NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra 领先新测试，AMD Instinct MI355X 与 Intel Arc Pro B 系列亦有提交；软件优化带来旧硬件上的提升。
facts.en: Third-party analysis (NAND Research) says NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra led the new tests, AMD Instinct MI355X and Intel Arc Pro B-series also submitted, and software optimisations lifted existing hardware.

caveat.zh: 只读了搜索摘要；“五项新增”的口径在新闻稿与分析文章之间不同，以 MLCommons 为准。逐系统成绩未核对。
caveat.en: Only search summaries were read; the “five new” count differs between the release and the analysis, so MLCommons’ wording governs. Per-system scores were not checked.

summary.zh: 新增两项混合专家（MoE）测试：DeepSeek V3（大）与 GPT-OSS 20B（小）。
summary.en: Two new mixture-of-experts tests: DeepSeek V3 (large) and GPT-OSS 20B (small).

facts.zh: 24个机构、95套系统、13种加速器；云系统数量约为六个月前 v5.1 的两倍；部分提交使用 FP4。
facts.en: 24 organisations, 95 unique systems, 13 accelerators; cloud systems roughly doubled versus v5.1 six months earlier; several submissions used FP4.

sources.label: Gigazine summary with links to results

caveat.zh: 领先厂商与具体时间未核对；见 MLCommons 结果页和厂商博客。
caveat.en: Which vendor led and the exact times were not checked; see the MLCommons results page and vendor posts.

summary.zh: 参与度创纪录：30个机构、120套系统、486项数据中心与边缘结果；新增端到端 RAG 流水线与边缘智能体推理测试。
summary.en: Record participation: 30 organisations, 120 systems, 486 datacenter and edge results; adds an end-to-end RAG pipeline test and an edge agentic-inference test.

facts.zh: MLCommons称相对一年前最高提升5.7倍。
facts.en: MLCommons reports up to 5.7× gain versus one year ago.

facts.zh: 首次同行评审结果：NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72、AMD Instinct MI350P、Intel Arc Pro B70；Crusoe 的512块 MI355X 提交是 MLPerf Inference 迄今最大系统。
facts.en: First peer-reviewed results for NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72, AMD Instinct MI350P and Intel Arc Pro B70; Crusoe’s 512-GPU MI355X run is the largest system ever submitted to MLPerf Inference.

facts.zh: 过半提交者使用新的以API为中心的测试框架，MLCommons计划以此支撑替代数据中心推理基准的“MLPerf Endpoints”。
facts.en: More than half of submitters used a new API-centric harness that MLCommons says will underpin “MLPerf Endpoints”, a planned replacement for the datacenter inference benchmark.

facts.zh: Intel 自报 Xeon 6980P 在 Llama 3.1 8B Server 上较 v6.0 提升2.4倍（同硅、同路数）；这是厂商自报。
facts.en: Intel self-reports a 2.4× Llama 3.1 8B Server gain on Xeon 6980P versus v6.0 on the same silicon and socket count; this is a vendor claim.

sources.label: StorageReview: 5.7× gains, 512-GPU run, Vera Rubin numbers

caveat.zh: 只读了搜索摘要，未核对每系统成绩；“最高5.7倍”是峰值，不是平均提升。
caveat.en: Only search summaries were read and per-system scores were not checked; “up to 5.7×” is a peak, not an average gain.

summary.zh: 新增 KV 缓存与向量数据库两项推理侧存储测试，并支持 S3 对象存储访问层；模拟加速器由 H100 改为 B200，因此不能与 v2.0 直接比较。
summary.en: Adds KV-cache and vector-database storage tests for inference, plus S3 object-storage access; simulated accelerators moved from H100 to B200, so results are not comparable with v2.0.

facts.zh: 19个机构、143项结果，其中11家首次提交（含 Azure、NVIDIA、Nebius）。
facts.en: 19 organisations and 143 results, including 11 first-time submitters (Azure, NVIDIA and Nebius among them).

facts.zh: 媒体转述的峰值：KV 缓存读 1,623.4 GiB/s（51主机 FlashBlade//EXA），向量库 57,620 QPS；这是厂商提交的系统，不是通用基线。
facts.en: Press-reported peaks: KV-cache read 1,623.4 GiB/s (51-host FlashBlade//EXA) and 57,620 QPS for vector DB; these are vendor-submitted systems, not a general baseline.

caveat.zh: 只读了搜索摘要；各数字来自二手报道，未对照 MLCommons 结果页。
caveat.en: Only search summaries were read; figures come from secondary reports and were not checked against the MLCommons results page.

summary.zh: 九年来第一次更新：评估70多个候选应用，选定38个，构成52个基准（CPU2017为43个）；源码量超过两倍，新增 LLVM 编译器、Python 解释器、国际象棋引擎等。
summary.en: The first new SPEC CPU in nine years: more than 70 candidate applications evaluated, 38 selected, 52 benchmarks (CPU2017 had 43); more than twice the source lines, with new LLVM-compiler, Python-interpreter and chess-engine workloads.

facts.zh: SPECspeed Integer 加入面向高核数CPU的显式并行，内存上限由16GB升至64GB；语言标准更新为 C++17、C18、Fortran 2018；新增开源编译器类别；裸金属云平台正式纳入运行与报告。
facts.en: SPECspeed Integer gains explicit parallelism for high-core-count CPUs and a memory allowance raised from 16GB to 64GB; language standards move to C++17, C18 and Fortran 2018; a new open-source-compiler category is added; bare-metal cloud platforms are formally supported.
Licence: $3,000 for new customers; $2,000 for current licensees until 3 November 2026.

facts.zh: 规则要点（CPU2017规则，CPU2026版另有页面）：base 编译不得使用反馈优化与断言标志；SPECspeed 允许编译器并行，SPECrate 不允许；公开披露须遵守规则，否则须标为估计值。
facts.en: Rule points (CPU2017 rules; CPU2026 has its own page): base builds may not use feedback-directed optimisation or assertion flags; compiler parallelisation is allowed for SPECspeed but not SPECrate; public disclosure must follow the rules or be labelled an estimate.

sources.label: SPEC CPU 2026 run and reporting rules
SPEC CPU 2017 run and reporting rules

caveat.zh: 新闻稿正文已读；规则页只看到目录摘要。本页没有采集任何 CPU 2026 具体得分，也不与 CPU2017 分数换算——两套套件不可直接比较。供应商（如 Supermicro）已发布结果，属营销来源。
caveat.en: The press release was read; the rules pages were seen only as table-of-contents excerpts. No SPEC CPU 2026 scores are captured here and CPU2017 scores cannot be converted — the suites are not directly comparable. Vendors such as Supermicro have published results; those are marketing sources.

summary.zh: 开源、持续运行的推理基准（Apache 2.0）；v2 报告覆盖 GB300 NVL72、MI355X、B200、H100，含解耦服务、宽专家并行与大型MoE模型，框架包括 SGLang、vLLM、TensorRT-LLM。
summary.en: An open-source, continuously run inference benchmark (Apache 2.0); the v2 report covers GB300 NVL72, MI355X, B200 and H100, including disaggregated serving, wide expert parallelism and large MoE models across SGLang, vLLM and TensorRT-LLM.

facts.zh: 方法主张：应在不同交互性/延迟水平上读吞吐，而不是只看峰值。
facts.en: Methodological stance: read throughput across interactivity levels, not just the peak.

facts.zh: 英伟达、AMD 各自引用该基准宣称的代际提升（最高约4倍／5倍）是厂商表述。
facts.en: NVIDIA and AMD each cite generational gains from it (up to about 4× and 5×); those are vendor framings.

caveat.zh: 报告全文付费，未读到具体数值；与 MLPerf 不同，它不是同行评审的提交制，而是SemiAnalysis自己运行。
caveat.en: The full report is paywalled and numeric results were not read; unlike MLPerf it is run by SemiAnalysis itself, not a peer-reviewed submission process.

title.zh: AgentSysBench（智能体负载的系统基准）
title.en: AgentSysBench (a systems benchmark for agentic workloads)

summary.zh: HKUST 团队（含阿里巴巴、字节跳动合作者）的 arXiv 论文提出的基准套件与测量工具：10个代表性智能体应用（RAG、HuggingGPT、DeepResearch、Mini-SWE、Codex、WebAgent、GUIAgent、Claude Code、Openclaw、Pi-AutoR），模块化服务栈（LLM引擎、向量库、沙箱、浏览器/GUI环境等，Docker部署），统一的逐操作追踪，记录时延、I/O、token与成本。
summary.en: A benchmark suite and measurement toolkit from an arXiv paper by an HKUST team (with Alibaba and ByteDance co-authors): ten representative agentic applications (RAG, HuggingGPT, DeepResearch, Mini-SWE, Codex, WebAgent, GUIAgent, Claude Code, Openclaw, Pi-AutoR), a modular serving stack (LLM engines, vector DBs, sandboxes, browser/GUI environments, in Docker), and unified per-operation tracing of latency, I/O, tokens and cost.

facts.zh: 规模：受控运行4,641个请求、64,924次LLM调用、118,274次工具调用；另有一天内3个应用的178,799个生产会话。
facts.en: Scale: 4,641 requests, 64,924 LLM calls and 118,274 tool calls in controlled runs, plus 178,799 production sessions of three applications over one day.

facts.zh: 发现1：执行时间长且不由LLM主导——约半数应用中非LLM组件占关键路径；GUIAgent 桌面沙箱占70%以上，Pi-AutoR 实验运行占约90%。
facts.en: Finding 1: execution is long and not LLM-dominated — non-LLM components dominate the critical path in about half the applications; the desktop sandbox exceeds 70% of GUIAgent time and experiment runtimes about 90% of Pi-AutoR.

facts.zh: 发现2：状态很重——一个 Claude Code 会话 KV 缓存最高约11 GB GPU 内存；沙箱单会话 DRAM 峰值可达28 GB（中位约0.8 GB）；前缀缓存命中率在 Claude Code 可达99%，DeepResearch 仅1%或更低。
facts.en: Finding 2: state is heavy — one Claude Code session can hold up to about 11 GB of KV cache in GPU memory; per-session sandbox DRAM peaks reach 28 GB (median about 0.8 GB); prefix-cache hit rate reaches 99% for Claude Code but 1% or lower for DeepResearch.

facts.zh: 发现3：异质与干扰——同一组件上不同任务时延相差最多32倍；重度后台文档嵌入使查询嵌入时延从5.6 ms升到200 ms（35.7倍）；8个并发沙箱共享CPU慢1.22倍。
facts.en: Finding 3: heterogeneity and interference — tasks on one component differ up to 32× in latency; heavy background document embedding lifts query-embedding latency from 5.6 ms to 200 ms (35.7×); eight concurrent sandboxes sharing CPUs slow by 1.22×.

facts.zh: 发现4：成本不只是token——Pi-AutoR 按量计费时沙箱费用占单请求成本99%以上；生产会话中位数仅20%的生命周期在执行，59.4%的会话至少一次超过5分钟KV缓存TTL，缓存驱逐占聚合成本的31.5%（按 Claude Opus 4.6 价格估算）。
facts.en: Finding 4: cost is not only tokens — sandbox charges exceed 99% of per-request cost for Pi-AutoR under pay-as-you-go; the median production session executes for only 20% of its lifetime, 59.4% of sessions let the 5-minute KV-cache TTL expire at least once, and cache evictions account for 31.5% of aggregate cost (estimated at Claude Opus 4.6 prices).

facts.zh: 作者的初步设计探索：任务感知调度降时延29–40%；通信感知放置最高4.5倍；状态卸载内存降4.6倍；工具结果缓存去掉35.2%的冗余搜索调用。
facts.en: The authors’ preliminary design explorations: task-aware serving cuts latency 29–40%; communication-aware placement up to 4.5×; state offloading cuts memory 4.6×; tool-result caching removes 35.2% of redundant search calls.

sources.label: arXiv 2608.15127: From LLM Inference to Agentic Workloads (AgentSysBench)

caveat.zh: 预印本，未经同行评审；读了论文前约十万字符（共约13.8万）。受控实验用单台GPU服务器、部分模型走API；生产追踪仅三个应用、一天；成本按公开标价估算；作者称“将开源”，文中未见仓库链接，所以目前不能自行复现，也没有排行榜或跨厂商硬件得分。
caveat.en: A preprint, not peer reviewed; about the first 100,000 of 138,000 characters were read. Controlled runs use a single GPU server with some models via API; production traces cover three applications over one day; costs are estimates from public list prices; the authors say they “will release” it as open source and no repository link appears, so it cannot yet be reproduced and has no leaderboard or cross-vendor hardware scores.

summary.zh: Verified 是500个仅Python的真实代码库问题，被普遍认为已被污染；Pro（Scale AI）有1,865个任务、41个代码库，覆盖多语言，设计上更难污染。
summary.en: Verified is 500 Python-only real-repository issues, widely considered contaminated; Pro (Scale AI) has 1,865 tasks across 41 repositories in several languages and is designed to resist contamination.

facts.zh: 同一模型的分数随口径剧烈变化：Scale AI 标准化 SEAL 榜在2026年3月的最高约46%，而厂商发布稿自报可达约80%；Verified 的聚合站快照已在90%以上。
facts.en: Scores swing with basis: Scale AI’s standardised SEAL board topped out around 46% in March 2026, while vendor launch posts self-report around 80%; aggregator snapshots of Verified are above 90%.

caveat.zh: 没有找到单一权威榜；聚合站互相矛盾，所以此处不给领先者。以 swebench.com 与 Scale AI SEAL 页面为准。
caveat.en: No single authoritative board was found and aggregators contradict each other, so no leader is named. Check swebench.com and Scale AI’s SEAL page.

summary.zh: 89个终端环境任务，涵盖软件工程、生物、安全与游戏，测量智能体在真实命令行中完成任务的能力。
summary.en: 89 terminal-environment tasks across software engineering, biology, security and gaming, measuring whether an agent can finish real command-line work.

facts.zh: 2026年3月至9月的不同快照给出不同领先者与分数（约78%到88%），且大小取决于智能体外壳（harness）而不仅是模型。
facts.en: Snapshots from March to September 2026 give different leaders and scores (roughly 78% to 88%), and the result depends on the agent harness as well as the model.

sources.label: Codesota snapshot of the official board

caveat.zh: 官方榜未打开；快照之间矛盾，故不给排名。
caveat.en: The official board was not opened; snapshots contradict each other, so no ranking is given.

summary.zh: 在真实桌面环境中评估多模态智能体；人类基线约72%。据报道 Simular 的 Agent S 在2025年12月达到约72.6%，成为首个越过人类基线的案例。
summary.en: Evaluates multimodal agents in real desktop environments; the human baseline is about 72%. Simular’s Agent S is reported to have reached about 72.6% in December 2025, the first widely noted result above the human baseline.

facts.zh: 2026年的快照显示最高约80–86%，口径各异（部分自报、未审计）；分数不能跨 OSWorld 版本迁移，更难的 OSWorld 2.0 最高约20.6%。
facts.en: 2026 snapshots show a top of roughly 80–86% on varying bases (some self-reported and unaudited); scores do not transfer across OSWorld versions, and on the harder OSWorld 2.0 the best listed is about 20.6%.

sources.label: Buildmvpfast: OSWorld passed the human baseline
a16z: can agents use a computer yet

caveat.zh: 官方 xlang.ai 榜未读到；版本与自报口径不同的数字不可并列比较。
caveat.en: The official xlang.ai board was not read; numbers from different versions and self-report bases cannot be compared side by side.

summary.zh: 通用AI助手基准，分三个难度层级；HAL（普林斯顿）榜注重标准化与成本。截至2026-05-27，榜首约74.6%（一级约82%、二级约73%、三级约65%），人类约92%。
summary.en: A general AI-assistant benchmark in three difficulty levels; the HAL (Princeton) board stresses standardisation and cost. As of 2026-05-27 the top entry was about 74.6% (about 82% on Level 1, 73% on Level 2, 65% on Level 3) against about 92% for humans.

caveat.zh: HAL 页面只从搜索摘要读到；数字截至5月，之后可能已变。
caveat.en: The HAL page was read only through search summaries; figures are as of May and may have changed.

title.zh: METR 时间跨度（任务时长）

summary.zh: METR 用“模型以50%成功率能完成的人类任务时长”衡量智能体能力：2025年3月论文估计前沿模型约50分钟，自2019年起约每7个月翻倍。
summary.en: METR measures agent capability as the human task length a model completes with 50% success: its March 2025 paper put frontier models at about 50 minutes, doubling roughly every seven months since 2019.

facts.zh: 2026年1月的 Time Horizon 1.1 更新称2023年以来翻倍时间约130.8天（4.3个月）；有二手来源称某模型约719分钟（约12小时）。
facts.en: The January 2026 Time Horizon 1.1 update puts the post-2023 doubling time at about 130.8 days (4.3 months); one secondary source cites about 719 minutes (about 12 hours) for a model.

sources.label: METR: Measuring AI Ability to Complete Long Tasks (arXiv)

caveat.zh: 2026年的数字来自二手来源，未读 METR 官网；“50%时间跨度”意味着该长度任务约一半会失败，不能读作“能独立工作多少小时”；对样本量与人类基线的批评亦存在。
caveat.en: The 2026 figures are secondary and METR’s own site was not read; a “50% horizon” means about half of tasks of that length fail, so it must not be read as “works unattended for N hours”; critiques about sample size and human baselines exist.

summary.zh: 覆盖美国GDP占比超过5%的9个行业中的44个职业，完整集1,320个任务（开源“金”子集220个）；任务由平均14年经验的行业专家依据自身工作编写，交付物含文档、幻灯片、表格等；以盲评的专家两两比较（赢/平/输）打分。
summary.en: Covers 44 occupations in the nine US sectors each above 5% of GDP: 1,320 tasks in the full set (220 in the open-sourced gold subset); tasks were written by industry experts averaging 14 years of experience from their own work, with deliverables such as documents, slides and spreadsheets; scored by blinded pairwise expert comparison (win, tie, loss).

facts.zh: 论文（2025年10月）中金子集上最高为 Claude Opus 4.1，47.6%的交付物评为赢或平；GPT-5 赢率39.0%。在“先试一次、不行自己改”的流程下 GPT-5 比无辅助专家约快1.12倍、便宜1.18倍；多次重试取优可达约1.39倍和1.63倍。前沿表现大致随时间线性提升。
facts.en: In the paper (October 2025) the top model on the gold subset was Claude Opus 4.1 with 47.6% of deliverables rated win or tie; GPT-5 won 39.0% of the time. Under a “try once, then fix it yourself” workflow GPT-5 was about 1.12× faster and 1.18× cheaper than unaided experts; with best-of-n retries about 1.39× and 1.63×. Frontier performance improved roughly linearly over time.

facts.zh: 实验性自动评分器与人类专家一致率66%（人类互评71%）。Artificial Analysis 指数里的 GDPval-AA 是另一套用 Elo 的变体，不是同一个数。
facts.en: The experimental automated grader agreed with experts 66% of the time (71% human inter-rater). GDPval-AA in the Artificial Analysis index is a separate Elo-based variant, not the same number.

caveat.zh: 读了论文约93%（最后约6,600字符未读）。作者自陈：每个职业仅约30个任务；限于自包含、计算机上、精确说明的一次性任务，非交互；自动评分弱于人类；评估昂贵。分数为2025年10月的论文版本，后续模型与新版本未采集。
caveat.en: About 93% of the paper was read (the last ~6,600 characters were not). The authors state: only about 30 tasks per occupation; limited to self-contained, computer-based, precisely specified one-shot tasks, not interactive; automated grading is weaker than human; evaluation is expensive. Scores are the October 2025 paper’s; later models and versions are not captured.

summary.zh: 在零售、航空等领域模拟“用户—智能体—工具”的多轮对话：智能体要向用户收集信息、遵守书面政策并调用API。提出 pass^k：同一任务重复k次都成功的概率，用来暴露一致性缺口。
summary.en: Simulates multi-turn user–agent–tool conversations in domains such as retail and airline: the agent gathers information from a user, follows written policy and calls APIs. Proposes pass^k, the probability of succeeding on all k repeats of the same task, which exposes consistency gaps.

facts.zh: 原论文（2024年6月，Yao、Shinn、Razavi、Narasimhan）：gpt-4o 级函数调用智能体成功率不到50%，零售领域 pass^8 低于25%。Sierra 称目前最好的模型在零售的 pass^1 已超过80%。
facts.en: The original paper (June 2024, Yao, Shinn, Razavi, Narasimhan): function-calling agents such as gpt-4o succeed on fewer than 50% of tasks and pass^8 is below 25% in retail. Sierra says the best models now exceed 80% pass^1 in retail.

facts.zh: 后续版本：τ³-bench 在 τ²-bench 基础上新增银行知识检索领域、75+项任务质量修正与语音原生评测模式（来自 evalscope 文档，二手）；τ²与τ³不能装在同一环境。Artificial Analysis 的指数已用 AutomationBench-AA 取代 τ³-Banking。
facts.en: Later versions: τ³-bench builds on τ²-bench with a banking knowledge-retrieval domain, 75+ task-quality fixes and an audio-native mode (from evalscope docs, secondary); τ² and τ³ cannot be installed in the same environment. The Artificial Analysis index has replaced τ³-Banking with AutomationBench-AA.

caveat.zh: 读了论文摘要与 Sierra 博客，没读全文；领域覆盖窄（零售、航空为主）；用户由模型模拟。τ²/τ³ 的变化只来自二手文档。
caveat.en: The paper abstract and Sierra’s blog were read, not the full paper; domain coverage is narrow (mainly retail and airline) and the user is simulated by a model. Changes in τ² and τ³ come only from secondary documentation.

title.zh: MCP-Atlas（Scale AI，真实 MCP 服务器的工具使用）
title.en: MCP-Atlas (Scale AI, tool use against real MCP servers)

summary.zh: 1,000个任务，36个真实 MCP 服务器、220个工具；每个任务暴露10–25个工具（3–7个目标、5–10个干扰），引出3–6次调用，目标工具至少来自两个服务器，约三分之一含条件分支。
summary.en: 1,000 tasks against 36 real MCP servers and 220 tools; each task exposes 10–25 tools (3–7 targets, 5–10 distractors), elicits 3–6 calls, with target tools from at least two servers and about one-third of tasks involving conditional branching.

facts.zh: 评分：每条“主张”记1/0.5/0；覆盖分为平均值，覆盖分≥0.75算通过；评审模型与人类多数票一致率78%。500题公开、500题保留以保护榜单。
facts.en: Scoring: each claim scores 1, 0.5 or 0; the coverage score is the mean and coverage ≥0.75 passes; the judge model agrees with the human majority 78% of the time. 500 tasks are public and 500 held out to protect the leaderboard.

facts.zh: 论文中最高为 Claude Opus 4.5，通过率62.3%（平均覆盖78.5%），其后 Gemini 3 Pro 54.1%、GPT-5 44.5%；失败多为工具使用（平均56.7%）与任务理解（30.3%）；最常见的具体失败是“没有调用任何工具”（平均36.0%）。
facts.en: In the paper the top was Claude Opus 4.5 at 62.3% pass (78.5% mean coverage), then Gemini 3 Pro 54.1% and GPT-5 44.5%; failures were mostly tool usage (56.7% on average) and task understanding (30.3%); the most common specific failure was calling no tools (36.0% on average).

caveat.zh: 作者自陈：仅单轮交互（不评恢复与重规划）、只读操作（排除改变状态的流程）、效率只记录不计分、实时API可能漂移；诊断指标不公开。这是2026年1月的论文数字，之后的模型未采集。
caveat.en: Authors state: single-turn only (recovery and replanning are not scored), read-only operations (state-changing workflows excluded), efficiency logged but not scored, live APIs may drift; diagnostics are not released. These are the January 2026 paper’s numbers; later models are not captured.

summary.zh: HKUST、All Hands AI、CMU、Duke 的 ICLR 2026 论文：32个软件应用、604个工具，从 Google Calendar、Notion 到 WooCommerce、Kubernetes、BigQuery；大多数工具基于 MCP 服务器；108个人工收集或编写的任务，每个都由专门脚本严格验证。
summary.en: An ICLR 2026 paper from HKUST, All Hands AI, CMU and Duke: 32 software applications and 604 tools, from Google Calendar and Notion to WooCommerce, Kubernetes and BigQuery; most tools are based on MCP servers; 108 manually sourced or crafted tasks, each strictly verified by dedicated scripts.

facts.zh: 论文摘要：v1 最佳模型 Claude-4-Sonnet 成功率仅29.9%（平均28轮调用）；后续版本为 Claude-4.5-Sonnet 38.6%（平均20.2轮）——数字随论文版本变化。
facts.en: Abstract: in v1 the best model, Claude-4-Sonnet, reached only 29.9% success with 28 tool-calling turns on average; a later version reports Claude-4.5-Sonnet at 38.6% with 20.2 turns — the numbers change between paper versions.

caveat.zh: 只读了搜索摘要，没打开论文；只有108个任务，规模小于 MCP-Atlas，但每题可脚本验证、含状态改变；2026年的最新结果未采集。
caveat.en: Only search summaries were read; the paper was not opened. With 108 tasks it is smaller than MCP-Atlas, but each task is script-verifiable and includes state changes; 2026 results are not captured.

summary.zh: 1,266个“难找但易验证”的短答案问题（原1,287个，审查后删除21个）：出题者先选种子事实，再用“倒推”方式构造搜索空间很大的问题，并确认 GPT-4o、o1 与早期 Deep Research 无法解答、五次简单 Google 搜索也找不到。
summary.en: 1,266 “hard to find, easy to verify” short-answer questions (1,287 originally, 21 removed after review): trainers start from a seed fact and build an “inverted” question with a large search space, confirming that GPT-4o, o1 and an early Deep Research model could not solve it and that five simple Google searches did not reveal the answer.

facts.zh: 人类：1,255题中解出367题（29.2%），888题（70.8%）两小时后放弃。模型（论文）：Deep Research 51.5%（校准误差91%，并说明它被专门针对此类任务训练），o1 9.9%，GPT-4o 加浏览 1.9%。
facts.en: Humans: 367 of 1,255 attempted questions solved (29.2%), 888 (70.8%) given up after two hours. Models (paper): Deep Research 51.5% (calibration error 91%, trained on data targeting such tasks), o1 9.9%, GPT-4o with browsing 1.9%.

facts.zh: 准确率随测试时算力平滑上升；64次采样下多数投票、加权投票和 best-of-N 比单次提高约15–25%。
facts.en: Accuracy scales smoothly with test-time compute; with 64 samples, majority vote, weighted vote and best-of-N each improve about 15–25% over one attempt.

caveat.zh: 作者自陈：不代表真实用户查询分布，不测长答案或歧义处理；答案唯一性无法完全验证；由AI判断语义等价；出题者并非竞赛级检索者；带浏览的模型校准差。数字是2025年4月论文的，之后的模型未采集；它对基础设施的意义是：准确率随浏览与采样算力上升，也就是随 token 与工具调用上升。
caveat.en: Authors state: it does not reflect real user query distributions and does not test long answers or ambiguity; answer uniqueness cannot be fully verified; an AI judges semantic equivalence; trainers were not competition-level searchers; browsing models are poorly calibrated. Figures are the April 2025 paper’s; later models are not captured. Infrastructure relevance: accuracy rises with browsing and sampling compute, that is with tokens and tool calls.

summary.zh: 把10项评测加权平均成一个数：智能体30%（AA-Briefcase 15、GDPval-AA 10、AutomationBench-AA 5）、编码20%（Terminal-Bench 4.0 10、SciCode 10）、科学推理20%（HLE 10、CritPt 10）、通用30%（AA-Omniscience 15、GDP.pdf 10、AA-LCR 5）。权重明显偏向智能体任务。
summary.en: Averages ten evaluations into one number, weighted: agents 30% (AA-Briefcase 15, GDPval-AA 10, AutomationBench-AA 5), coding 20% (Terminal-Bench 4.0 10, SciCode 10), scientific reasoning 20% (HLE 10, CritPt 10), general 30% (AA-Omniscience 15, GDP.pdf 10, AA-LCR 5). The weighting clearly favours agentic tasks.

facts.zh: 方法页当前版本为 v4.3.2；v4.1 时只有9项评测、智能体34%；评测集每个版本都在换，v4.1 之后 τ³-Banking 已被 AutomationBench-AA 取代。
facts.en: The methodology page shows v4.3.2; v4.1 had nine evaluations with agents at 34%; the evaluation set changes with each version, and τ³-Banking was replaced by AutomationBench-AA after v4.1.

facts.zh: 运行方式：多数评测只跑一次，Terminal-Bench 4.0、SciCode、AA-LCR 跑3次，GDP.pdf、CritPt 跑5次，按 pass@1 汇总；基于 Elo 的评测给出95%置信区间；AA-Briefcase、AutomationBench-AA（657题私有保留集）、AA-Omniscience、CritPt 为私有评测，据称私有/保留评测权重占45%。
facts.en: How runs work: most evaluations run once, Terminal-Bench 4.0, SciCode and AA-LCR three times, GDP.pdf and CritPt five times, aggregated as pass@1; Elo-based evaluations get 95% confidence intervals; AA-Briefcase, AutomationBench-AA (a private 657-task held-out split), AA-Omniscience and CritPt are private, and private or held-out evaluations are reported at 45% of the weight.

facts.zh: 由 Artificial Analysis 自己运行（页面未称“独立”）；部分评测来自外部方（Zapier、Harvey、Surge AI）；评分用前沿LLM作评审，部分用三评审团。成本按各API提供商报告的token数计算。
facts.en: Run by Artificial Analysis itself (the page does not say “independent”); some evaluations come from outside parties (Zapier, Harvey, Surge AI); frontier LLMs act as judges, with a three-judge panel for some. Cost uses token counts reported by each API provider.

facts.zh: 页面自陈的局限：主要是英文文本；HLE 题目曾用旧模型对抗筛选，不宜与未参与筛选的模型直接比较；不同版本分数不可比；参考归一化参数可能更新。
facts.en: Limits the page states itself: mostly English text; HLE questions were adversarially selected with older models, so comparisons with models outside that process are discouraged; scores are not comparable across versions; reference normalisation parameters may be updated.

caveat.zh: 读了方法页前约一半（共约18万字符，后半未读）；v4.3 公告日期来自搜索摘要。综合指数把不同评测压成一个数，权重选择本身是判断。
caveat.en: About the first half of the methodology page was read (about 180,000 characters; the rest was not), and the v4.3 announcement date comes from a search summary. A composite compresses different evaluations into one number, and the weight choices are themselves judgements.

title.zh: Artificial Analysis 速度、价格与硬件基准
title.en: Artificial Analysis speed, price and hardware benchmarks

summary.zh: 除智能指数外，Artificial Analysis 还对各推理提供商持续测量输出速度（token/秒）、首token延迟和每百万token价格；其招聘页称也在为新加速器与推理配置做吞吐与性价比基准。这些数字衡量的是托管服务，而不是某块芯片。
summary.en: Besides the Intelligence Index, Artificial Analysis continuously measures output speed (tokens per second), time to first token and price per million tokens across inference providers; its job listing says it also benchmarks throughput and price-performance for new accelerators and inference configurations. These numbers describe hosted services, not a particular chip.

facts.zh: 读“每秒token”时先分清：单用户速度，还是整个部署的总吞吐；每GPU，还是每系统/每机架。有报道的250万 token/秒来自4个机架的288块 Blackwell Ultra，除以芯片数并不是 MLCommons 的官方指标。
facts.en: Before reading “tokens per second”, separate per-user speed from total deployment throughput, and per-GPU from per-system or per-rack. One reported 2.5 million tokens per second came from 288 Blackwell Ultra GPUs across four racks, and dividing by chip count is not an official MLCommons metric.

sources.label: Artificial Analysis careers: AI hardware product manager (describes the hardware benchmarking)

caveat.zh: 没有读到 Artificial Analysis 自己的硬件页面，不引用具体硬件数字；提供商速度随负载、批量与时间变化。
caveat.en: Artificial Analysis’s own hardware page was not read, so no hardware figures are cited; provider speeds vary with load, batching and time.

title.zh: CursorBench（Cursor 第一方编码智能体评测）

summary.zh: 任务来自真实 Cursor 会话：Cursor Blame 把已提交代码追溯到产生它的智能体请求，从而得到“开发者请求 + 真实解答”；任务描述刻意简短含糊；由智能体评分器打分，可接受多种正确答案；每几个月刷新。
summary.en: Tasks come from real Cursor sessions: Cursor Blame traces committed code back to the agent request that produced it, pairing a developer request with a ground-truth solution; task descriptions are deliberately short and underspecified; agentic graders score them and accept multiple correct answers; the set is refreshed every few months.

facts.zh: 衡量正确性、代码质量、效率与交互行为（文章重点是正确性）；Epoch 转载的榜单同时给出每任务平均成本、token 数和智能体步数，且同一模型常按多个推理强度分别列出。
facts.en: Measures correctness, code quality, efficiency and interaction behaviour (the post focuses on correctness); the leaderboard Epoch relays also reports average cost, tokens and agent steps per task, with the same model often listed at several reasoning-effort levels.

facts.zh: 版本：Cursor 文章称生产版本为3.1（可能与文中数字不同，须在同一版本内比较）；Epoch 称榜单自2026-09-10起为 v4.0，且与 3.x 不可比。
facts.en: Versions: Cursor’s post says production is 3.1 (scores can shift from the post and must be compared within one version); Epoch says the board has been v4.0 since 10 September 2026 and is not comparable with 3.x.

facts.zh: 文章承认：代码行数是难度的不完美度量；未报告样本量、置信区间或显著性；离线评分可能给开发者觉得更差的输出打高分，所以并用在线评测。
facts.en: The post concedes lines of code is an imperfect measure of difficulty; it reports no sample sizes, confidence intervals or significance tests; offline graders can score well on outputs developers find worse, which is why online evaluations are used alongside.

sources.label: Cursor: How we evaluate models with CursorBench

caveat.zh: 这是评测所有者自己的套件，任务集与评分器不公开，外部无法复现；别家聚合站只作参考展示、不计入总榜。文章正文没有具体分数，本页不引用任何排名。
caveat.en: This is the evaluation owner’s own suite; the task set and graders are not public, so outsiders cannot reproduce it; some aggregators show it for reference only and exclude it from overall rankings. The post text gives no numeric scores and this page cites no ranking.

title.zh: 智能体基准如何连到基础设施
title.en: How agentic benchmarks connect to infrastructure

summary.zh: 智能体基准给的是任务成功率，不是 token、时延或成本。一个任务可能包含数十到数百次模型调用与大量 CPU 侧工具执行，并带着很长的上下文与 KV 缓存。读榜单时问：1) 是单次成功（pass@1）还是多次取最佳？2) 用了什么外壳与工具？3) 每任务消耗多少 token、多长墙钟时间、多少费用？4) 任务是否可能已在训练数据里？基础设施层面，MLPerf Inference v6.1 的边缘智能体测试与 MLPerf Storage v3.0 的 KV 缓存测试是首批把这类负载纳入基准的尝试。 5) 评测由谁运行：第三方、社区榜，还是产品方自己的套件（如 CursorBench）？第一方套件贴近真实用法，但不可复现，也不能与公开榜直接并列。6) 同一模型换外壳，分数可相差20–30分，比较时必须固定外壳。 AgentSysBench（M18）是首批从系统侧量化这些问题的工作：非LLM组件占关键路径、KV缓存状态与TTL过期、沙箱计费。 可靠性用 pass^k（M20）读，不要只看 pass@1；浏览与检索类准确率会随采样与工具调用算力上升（M23）。
summary.en: Agentic benchmarks report task success, not tokens, latency or cost. One task can involve tens to hundreds of model calls and heavy CPU-side tool execution, carrying very long context and KV cache. When reading a leaderboard ask: 1) pass@1 or best-of-n? 2) which harness and tools? 3) how many tokens, how much wall-clock time and cost per task? 4) could the tasks be in the training data? At the infrastructure level, the MLPerf Inference v6.1 edge agentic test and the MLPerf Storage v3.0 KV-cache test are first attempts to bring such workloads into benchmarks. 5) Who runs the evaluation: a third party, a community board or the product owner’s own suite (such as CursorBench)? First-party suites sit close to real use but cannot be reproduced and should not be set side by side with public boards. 6) The same model can swing 20–30 points between harnesses, so the harness must be held fixed. AgentSysBench (M18) is among the first works to quantify these from the systems side: non-LLM components on the critical path, KV-cache state and TTL expiry, and sandbox billing. Read reliability with pass^k (M20), not only pass@1; browsing and retrieval accuracy rises with sampling and tool-call compute (M23).

facts.zh: 二手来源称，外壳（scaffold）可使 SWE-bench Pro 上同一模型相差约22分；另一来源称三种外壳可使同一模型上下摆动30分。
facts.en: Secondary sources say the scaffold accounts for about a 22-point swing on SWE-bench Pro for the same model, and another says three scaffolds can swing one model by 30 points.

caveat.zh: 编辑性阅读指南；外壳摆动幅度来自二手博客，未核对原榜单。
caveat.en: An editorial reading guide; the harness-swing figures come from secondary blogs and were not checked against the original boards.

title.zh: 尚未覆盖的基准与成本口径
title.en: Benchmarks and cost bases not yet covered

summary.zh: 1) 封闭还是开放组？开放组可改模型与算法，不能与封闭组直接比。2) 每加速器还是整系统？系统规模不同，比较单位要对齐。3) 是同一硅的软件提升还是新硬件？v6.1 的 Intel 例子来自同一硅。4) 精度（FP8/FP4）与准确度门槛是否相同？5) 有没有功耗与成本列？功耗测量是可选提交，价格不在结果表里。6) 基准负载是否像你的生产负载（上下文长度、批量、延迟约束）？
summary.en: 1) Closed or open division? The open division may change the model or algorithm and cannot be compared directly with closed. 2) Per accelerator or whole system? Align the unit. 3) Software gain on the same silicon or new hardware? Intel’s v6.1 example is same-silicon. 4) Same precision (FP8/FP4) and accuracy bar? 5) Is there a power and cost column? Power measurement is an optional submission and price is not in the result tables. 6) Does the benchmark resemble your production workload (context length, batch, latency constraint)?

caveat.zh: 编辑性阅读指南，不是 MLCommons 规则全文；规则以其文档为准。
caveat.en: An editorial reading guide, not the full MLCommons rules; the rules are in its documents.

title.zh: 尚未覆盖的基准与成本口径
title.en: Benchmarks and cost bases not yet covered

summary.zh: 已纳入：MLPerf 推理/训练/存储、InferenceX、SPEC CPU 2026、AgentSysBench、十个智能体基准（SWE-bench、Terminal-Bench、OSWorld、GAIA、METR、GDPval、τ-bench、MCP-Atlas、Toolathlon、BrowseComp）、Artificial Analysis 指数与 CursorBench。尚未纳入：MLPerf Client/Automotive、SPEC 功耗与 ML 套件、MLE-bench、Vending-Bench、WebArena、LiveCodeBench、Aider Polyglot、SWE-Lancer、Arena WebDev（人类偏好榜）、Artificial Analysis 的具体硬件数字，以及云实例真实价格与每美元/每瓦特口径；加入前须核实方法与来源。
summary.en: Now included: MLPerf inference, training and storage, InferenceX, SPEC CPU 2026, AgentSysBench, ten agentic benchmarks (SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench, OSWorld, GAIA, METR, GDPval, τ-bench, MCP-Atlas, Toolathlon, BrowseComp), the Artificial Analysis index and CursorBench. Not yet included: MLPerf Client and Automotive, SPEC power and ML suites, MLE-bench, Vending-Bench, WebArena, LiveCodeBench, Aider Polyglot, SWE-Lancer, Arena WebDev (a human-preference board), Artificial Analysis’s hardware figures, and real cloud-instance prices and per-dollar / per-watt bases; method and source must be checked before adding.

caveat.zh: 这是已知缺口，不是“没有这类基准”的结论。
caveat.en: This is a known gap, not a claim that no such benchmarks exist.
